Its documented workflow is that a user asks an AI tool for a landing page, and the tool follows the installed landing-page skill. The skill covers intake questions, page structure, conversion copy, and a visual system. The skill file is listed in the tree but no source excerpt was provided, so the graph shows only README-documented capabilities and relationships, not internal sequencing.
